description: Resolve whether a US civil aircraft N-number is active, deregistered, reserved, or unknown, including the available registration and airworthiness status. Use this rather than faa_lookup_registration when a number may be inactive. A number that was never issued returns recordType "unknown" — a valid, informative answer, not an error. Accepts "N12345" or "12345".

nNumber.description: US registration N-number to resolve. Accepts "N12345" or "12345" (leading N optional). Shape: 1–5 characters — a leading digit 1–9, then digits, optionally ending in 1–2 letters (I and O are unused).

name: faa_get_registration_status

airworthinessClass.description: Airworthiness classification as code + label (active records).

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_n_number`: The input is not a structurally valid N-number (after the optional leading "N": 1–5 characters, a leading digit 1–9, then digits, optionally 1–2 trailing letters; I and O are unused). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

expirationNoticeDate.description: Date an expiration notice was sent, YYYY-MM-DD (reserved records).

modeSCodeHex.description: Mode S code in hex / ICAO 24-bit address (deregistered records).

nNumberDisplay.description: N-number with the leading "N" for display.

nNumberForChange.description: The N-number this reservation changes to/from (reserved records).

recordType.description: Resolved registration state: active, deregistered, reserved, or unknown.

reserveDate.description: Date the number was reserved, YYYY-MM-DD (reserved records).

status.description: Registration/cancellation status as code + label (active and deregistered records).

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

typeReservation.description: Type of reservation as code + label (reserved records).
